product.title: Primul Război Mondial. Cambrai 1917
product.description: O prezentare incitantă a marilor conflicte din Primul Război Mondial, cu descrieri detaliate ale strategiilor de comandă, ale tacticilor de luptă și ale bătăliilor dintre forțele armate opuse de-a lungul stadiilor cruciale ale unor campanii cheie. Băătălia de la Cambrai a marcat nașterea războiului de tancuri și a fost martora primei folosiri a vehiculelor blindate în rolul pentru care fuseseră concepute, anume acțiuni operative de șoc. În noiembrie 1917, Armata IIII Britanică a comasat un număr suficient de mare de tanccuri (aproximativ 400) pentru a covârși liniile germane de-a lungul unui front larg de 16 kilometri. Folosirea concomitentă a tirului de artilerie și implicarea avioanelor în sprijinul aerian de aproape au fost punctul de plecare a unei noi ere a felului de a purta războiul și a tehnicilor armelor combinate. Deși bătălia s-a teminat indecis, fără vreun câștig strategic, lecția învățată cu această ocazie a ajutat la dezvoltarea tacticilor care vor fi folosite cu succes pentru a câștiga războiul în anul 1918.

# First World War: Cambrai 1917 by Litera

## Explore the Turning Point of Modern Warfare

Delve into the monumental conflicts of the Great War with *First World War: Cambrai 1917*. Published by Litera, this non-fiction work offers an engaging and detailed presentation of the major battles and strategies that defined the First World War. It is an essential read for history enthusiasts seeking deep insights into military tactics, command structures, and the evolution of weaponry during one of humanity's most defining conflicts.

## The Significance of the Battle of Cambrai

The book focuses heavily on crucial campaigns, highlighting how major battles shaped the trajectory of the war. Central to its narrative is the pivotal **Battle of Cambrai in November 1917**. This battle was revolutionary because it marked the birth of tank warfare and featured some of the first systematic uses of armored vehicles for their intended operational shock roles.

The account details a massive operation undertaken by the British Fourth Army, which deployed an estimated 400 tanks to overwhelm German lines across a broad 16-kilometer front. The authors explore how the combined use of artillery shelling and close air support established a new era in warfareâthe combination of advanced technology and coordinated tactics.

While the battle concluded without clear strategic victory, its lessons were profound. This tactical experience proved critical, helping military strategists develop the doctrines that would ultimately prove successful during the victorious campaigns of 1918.

### What You Will Learn Inside:

*   **Advanced Tactics:** Detailed descriptions of command strategies and evolving battlefield tactics used by opposing forces.
*   **Combined Arms Warfare:** An understanding of how artillery, aircraft, and tanks were integrated for maximum effect, defining modern military theory.
*   **Historical Context:** A comprehensive look at the major campaigns that shaped the conflict from 1914â1918.

**Q: Is this book suitable for general readers or experts?**
A: The book provides an engaging presentation of complex military history, making it accessible to serious history enthusiasts while maintaining enough depth for dedicated students of the period.

**Q: Does the book cover only tank battles?**
A: No. While the Battle of Cambrai and its use of tanks are central themes, the book offers a broader scope, detailing strategies, artillery usage, and air support across multiple crucial stages of the First World War.
